releases.notes:
The first release: a DJ librarian that analyses your music with KeyTempo, lets you fix and prep it, and takes it
to rekordbox, Serato, Engine DJ, Traktor or straight onto a USB drive for the player.

### Library and analysis
- Watched folders, drag and drop, incremental rescans; missing files flagged and found again.
- KeyTempo analysis: BPM to 0.01 with an alternate reading, beat grid and downbeat, key / Camelot / Open Key,
  time signature. Tempo presets per genre family.
- Needs review queue, ×2 / ½ and BPM lock, search filters (`bpm:`, `key:`, `genre:`).
- Duplicate finder with keeper choice; duplicates are left, trashed or moved, never deleted.

### Genre tags and suggestions (#20, #21, #25)
- Several genre tags per track from a built-in library of 18 families, 124 genres and 409 styles, plus your own.
- Genre suggestions from analysis with Likely / Possible / Unsure confidence; nothing reaches files until accepted.

### Your files stay safe (#17)
- Every change to a file is shown and confirmed first; tag writes are backed up, read back and verified.
- History lists every change and can undo it, including duplicate removals and exports.

### Player and track prep (#26)
- Player with waveform, cues, scrubbing, auto-advance and output device choice.
- Grid editing, hot cues A–H, memory cues and loops, ratings and colours, tempo slider with key-lock.

### Appearance (#5, #32, #33)
- Themes, five fonts, text size 90–150%, interface scale up to 200% and row density.

### DJ software (#7, #8)
- Import rekordbox XML, Serato and Engine DJ libraries with a compare-and-merge review.
- Export rekordbox XML, Serato crates, Engine DJ libraries and Traktor NML; Serato cues, loops and grids written
  into audio files. Per-app MP3 timing offsets.

### Export to device (#31)
- One flow to put your library on a USB or SD drive: optional byte-for-byte audio copy, hash-verified, with
  incremental re-exports that never overwrite a file TrueGrid didn't copy.
- Formats on the drive: Engine DJ (Prime / SC), Pioneer CDJ / XDJ (`export.pdb` with grids, cues and waveforms),
  Serato, rekordbox XML and Traktor. The whole export can be undone from History.

### Updates (#40)
- TrueGrid checks for a newer version shortly after it starts and then daily (Help > Check for updates
  automatically), and Help > Check for Updates… checks now. A banner offers What's new, Download (the release page)
  and Skip this version; nothing is downloaded or installed by the app. Release candidates only with Help > Include
  release candidates.

### Command line
- `truegrid-cli` for scanning, listing, edits, duplicates, imports and every export, with `--dry-run` and `--yes`;
  `truegrid-cli version --check` for updates.

### Known limits
- Builds are not code-signed yet: macOS and Windows warn on first launch (see the README's Download section).
- Not yet checked on real players: Engine DJ and Pioneer exports are tested against format fixtures only.
- OneLibrary (CDJ-3000X, XDJ-AZ, OPUS-QUAD, OMNIS-DUO) is not written (#49). History / set import and two-way sync
  come later (#48).
